claim_summaries: Exact positive-curvature witnesses show the standard XXZ two-qubit gate is not log-concave for either gamma>alpha or gamma<-alpha.
Specialization and fixed multiaffine coefficient extraction preserve log-concavity, ruling out direct local LC ancilla lifts returning those gates.
A Pauli-axis permutation that moves gamma into the transverse pair creates a non-LC pair-flip signature, with an exact rational witness.
